mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_logs (job_name, started_at, status) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{startedAt}, 'FAILED')
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_logs SET finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, status = #{status}, message = #{message} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.job_name, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.duration_ms, b.processed_count, b.status, b.message FROM batch_logs b JOIN (SELECT job_name, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM batch_logs GROUP BY job_name) m ON m.max_id = b.id ORDER BY b.job_name
